sessions_audited.notes: Pricing updates and internal-page mobile/desktop polish for frenchatelierlive.com. Client attached a Lighthouse audit that measured the wrong repository (a disconnected June mockup, not the live site). Agent refused to provide any credit/cost range before starting work despite repeated direct requests, deflecting to a post-hoc usage dashboard.

cases.summary: Agent refused to give any range or ballpark of potential credit/cost consumption before starting tasks, repeatedly deflecting to a post-hoc usage dashboard the client cannot consult in advance. This denies the client the information needed to make an informed choice between Perplexity and an alternative tool, and leaves an open window for the exact failure pattern the client has repeatedly experienced: long ETAs and repeated retries on simple, fast assignments.
cases.compute_note: Preceded by three failed Lighthouse attempts against the live site (CLI default, CLI with software-render flags, direct Node API) and four failed browser-subagent audit batches retried twice, all consuming credits with no usable output before this exchange.
